leads.site_text:

Signatur Biosciences :: Expanding PCR testing to a whole new range of conditions 0 Skip to Content Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu We’re making precision diagnostics accessible around the planet. One disease at the time — starting with Breast Cancer Prognosis Our molecular technology makes diagnosing complex diseases simple. No need for laborious tests and expensive machines, our kits bring molecular intelligence to widely accessible PCR equipment. Traditional PCR can’t keep up with modern medicine. Conventional PCR tests detect one or two biomarkers — ideal for infections, but not for cancers or chronic diseases that depend on complex molecular patterns. To capture these patterns today, samples must be sent to specialised central laboratories, where analysis depends on sophisticated equipment, complex workflows, expert staff, and multi-step data processing. The result: high costs, long turnaround times, and limited access to precision diagnostics outside major reference centres — creating a real bottleneck for precision medicine adoption and leading to underserved disease areas. We simplify precision molecular diagnostics — without compromise. Signatur Biosciences’ platform transforms standard qPCR machines into powerful precision diagnostic tools. By condensing complex RNA signatures into a single PCR assay, we make precision diagnostics decentralised, faster, and more affordable — while maintaining the same clinical utility as reference-lab genomic assays. Built for compatibility with standard qPCR machines and workflows, our kits integrate seamlessly into existing hospital infrastructure, enabling clinicians to deliver precision insights within days, not weeks. Smarter tests. Covering more diseases. Supporting more people. Supported & backed by:

leads.posting: Team size: 12. AI-Powered ERP, MES, and Test Software for Complex Operations Epsilon3 is the AI-Powered ERP, MES, and Test Management Software for Complex Engineering, Manufacturing, & Operations. We are a growing team of engineers from SpaceX, NASA, Google, and Stanford with unique experience planning and executing over 100 space missions. We are applying what we learned to develop web-based solutions that make building and operating advanced systems as efficient, error-free, and enjoyable as possible. Want to join a fully remote, US-based SaaS startup on a mission to solve complex problems in aerospace, energy, defense, maritime, and biotech? Apply today! Epsilon3® | AI-powered Procedure & Resource Management Software 0 Skip to Content Request a Demo Open Menu Close Menu Request a Demo Open Menu Close Menu Epsilon3 is the operations platform for complex hardware. We run the build, test, operations, and sustainment lifecycle in a single connected platform that gets complex hardware built and in the field. Request a Demo TRUSTED BY THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL HARDWARE PROGRAMS IN THE COUNTRY WHAT WE DELIVER 98 % fewer execution errors versus paper checklists 20 x faster execution than paper procedures 3 x reduction in procedure management overhead 5 x faster procedure authoring THE PLATFORM One platform. Every capability you need. You are already doing all of this work, across a manufacturing system, a quality system, a maintenance system, a requirements tool, and the spreadsheets are filling every gap between them. Epsilon3 is where that work runs on one record instead of many. THE SOLUTION One connected platform at the core of your operations. One platform, every phase. From design through sustainment, one system holds the program together through every phase, team, and revision. One view, every role. The operator sees the current revision in real time. The engineer pulls a part's full history in a click. The director sees deviation rates and quality across every program. The auditor sees the whole trail immediately. One thread, every part. From the drawing through the build, the test, the deployment, the field event, the repair. Pull on any part of the thread and the program comes with it. Epsilon3 — Without / With SOFTWARE FOR MISSION-CRITICAL OPERATIONS Run Complex Programs Every phase writes to a different place, so nothing adds up to one record. WITH EPSILON3 WITHOUT EPSILON3 3 TOOLS FOR TEST DATA 5 PEOPLE CC-ED SCATTERED. DISCONNECTED. UNAUDITABLE. ONE RECORD — every phase writes to the same source of truth LIVE PROCEDURES Digital Execution SHARED SERVICES One Record One platform. One record. Complete traceability. ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AI that helps you speed up execution Every suggestion arrives as a proposal you accept or reject, not something you discover after the fact. That's a deliberate break from the agentic tools flooding this market, and it's why our customers actually turn AI on. Underneath, it's grounded in your own operating record: procedures, runs, sign-offs, deviations, test data, telemetry . 01 — Find it faster Ask the record instead of hunting through it. "Has this valve ever failed checkout?" "What changed between Rev 12 and Rev 14?" Ask across every program you've run and get an answer cited to the exact step, signature, and reading it came from, instead of six people and an afternoon. INSTITUTIONAL MEMORY , MADE QUERYABLE 02 — Decide faster It proposes. You accept. A schedule resequence, a procedure revision, a flagged inconsistency. Each one surfaces as a suggestion you approve or dismiss right where you’re working. Nothing applies itself, and every proposal leaves an audit trail whether you take it or not. HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP, BY DESIGN. 03—Start faster Productive right away. Onboarding agents walk a new team through configuration and answer from documentation that’s always current. The setup that used to take weeks takes under an hour, and the people who join in year three get the same answers as the people who built it. WEEKS TO UNDER AN HOUR 04—Keep your data yours Never trained on your data. Your data is not used to train models. Each call carries context for a single decision and then forgets it. Model-agnostic by architecture: we swap in better models as they ship, and on-prem or classified programs bring their own, including models you've tuned yourself. BYOM ON-PREM & AIR-GAPPED Ask Answers questions against the full record, cited back to the exact step, run, or reading. Suggest Proposes revisions, resequences, and flags. Surfaced for approval.
